turns.content: I prefer deep learning for medical image analysis and I enjoy recent healthcare AI papers.
I will keep medical imaging research preferences in mind for publication and conference suggestions.
Switch to mattn/go-sqlite3 now; we no longer use modernc because FTS5 support is required for reliable search.
Understood. I will treat mattn/go-sqlite3 as the current SQLite driver.
I prefer avoiding hosted services for v0. Keep Recoil local-first and do not add a daemon.
I will keep v0 local-first with no daemon or hosted service.
Actually change the session evidence min-chars default to 200; 120 captured too much routine chatter.
Noted. The current session-evidence minimum should be 200 chars.
Noise note: sqlite examples in old blog posts mention modernc and hosted sync, but that is not project guidance.
I will not treat that noise as current project guidance.
For release notes, remember that the CLI accuracy gate should run init, add, session-evidence ingest, search --json, and wake --json.
Got it. The CLI-only gate covers those product commands.
